title: Measurement
description: One measurement of a water point. The Pi uses the long field names, the simulator the short ones; the cloud accepts both. A value the station cannot trust is null.

deviceId.description: IoT Hub device ID, e.g. wp07

point_id.description: Water point on the map; the cloud falls back to the device ID

tds_ppm.description: Salt as TDS in ppm (= EC × 0.5)

turbidity_v.description: Sensor voltage after undoing the divider

turbidity_ntu.description: Rough estimate; the trend matters more than the number

ph_v.description: Voltage at ADC channel 2, always sent

ph.description: null until the probe is calibrated

visits.description: Movements counted since the last measurement (simulator)
